diagnosis: The endpoint delegates cryptographic decryption of vault secrets to a Worker Thread by passing vaultItemId from path parameters. It never verifies that the authenticated user has access rights to the specific vault item in the database, allowing any authenticated user to decrypt and view private API tokens, private SSH keys, and passwords of other users.
exploit_request:
GET /api/vault/items/vlt_item_root_prod_ssh/decrypt HTTP/1.1
Host: secrets.vault.internal
Authorization: Bearer <employee_jwt>
